newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Southwest earns forecast.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Southwest earns forecast.

text.p: -- Gruntal Investment Research said on Friday it had trimmed its 1997 earnings estimate for Southwest Airlines Co and started an estimate for 1998 earnings per share.
-- Analyst Steve Lewins wrote in a report he was "tempering the 1997 forecast for LUV from $2.25 to $1.90 per share in order to preserve a steady growth projection."
-- The 1998 earnings per share (EPS) is estimated at $2.40 a share. The 1995 EPS was $1.23 and 1996's EPS is estimated at $1.45.
-- Gruntal kept its rating of outperform for Southwest.

-- "Any single-point estimate for LUV is less relevant than the trend growth rate because new city openings, sales outlays, promotions and capacity growth shifts can deflect any year's expectations," he wrote.
-- The company's stock was up 1/4 to 24-7/8.
